name: com.classicspins.pf-iap-unity
description: An optional PrototypeFramework service module: the framework's IPurchaseService backed by Unity IAP 5 (com.unity.purchasing — App Store and Google Play), plus the Unity IAP replacement for the IapInit boot node. Grants go through the framework's GrantInterpreter once per store transaction; restore replays entitlement grants. Unity IAP is not a dependency here — it is declared in pf-module.json and installed through Framework/Setup Wizard ▸ Modules. Without it the module still compiles and refuses every purchase, logging pf-iap-unity, instead of falling back to the free-granting fake.
